turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Marcus. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm locked out of online banking. It keeps saying my password is wrong.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can reset that. First, let me verify your identity — can you confirm the last four of the card on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it ends in four four four four.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. I've sent a one-time code to the phone ending in one four two. Can you read me the code?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it. Your password is reset — you'll be prompted to choose a new one at next login.
